title: Area 51 was only Groom Lake; Dreamland was Areas 53 and 54
place_text: Nevada test ranges (Groom Lake, Indian Springs Valley, Dog Bone Valley, French Peak)

tellings.quote: Area 51 was not actually Dreamland itself. It was merely Groom Lake. Dreamland was area 53 and 54,

plain: A former Air Force weather observer named Charles Hall, who says he spent three years in the 1960s working alongside tall white aliens on the Nevada test ranges, says Area 51, the secret Air Force base in the Nevada desert, "was merely Groom Lake", the dry lakebed where it sits. He tells Michels that the real "Dreamland", the nickname often given to the secret area, "was area 53 and 54", covering places such as Indian Springs Valley, and he says he knows it from being there himself.
